subject: Streaming truncation during variant routing — SDK flag + telemetry ask
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Streaming truncation during variant routing — SDK flag + telemetry ask

Quick summary: Helio Health is seeing streaming responses truncate mid-token ~30% of the time when variant routing falls back (variant switch + prefetch enabled). Customer repro attached (helio_trace_20261118.txt) and a minimal sample (partial_response_sample.json).

Ask: Can the runtime + SDK teams evaluate two things in parallel: 1) a short-term runtime workaround (disable prefetch on variant fallback / tenant-level toggle) we can ship as a hotfix; 2) a product/SDK change to expose variant_id + cache_hit + prefetch_state in SDK telemetry/traces so sales/SEs can correlate hits with truncation in customer telemetry? Helio is blocked on stability for their live demo.

Observed behavior: streaming sequence starts, then after ~5-40 tokens the stream terminates with no finalization event (no "DONE" or close frame). Client sees EOF and marks response truncated. We reproduced with both Node SDK and curl streaming. Variant routing + prefetch appears correlated (disabled prefetch -> much lower rate).

Immediate ask from SE side:
- Runtime: Can we get a tenant flag to disable prefetch (or per-variant prefetch off) as a hotfix within 72 hours?
- SDK: Can we expose the following fields in the streaming trace event payload: variant_id, routed_variant_reason, kv_cache_hit (true/false), prefetch_triggered (true/false)? Minimal surface: add these into the existing streaming event envelope.

Attached: helio_trace_20261118.txt (server traces they collected), partial_response_sample.json (client capture).

Thanks — Tessa
---
Tessa Morgan
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Streaming truncation during variant routing — SDK flag + telemetry ask

Thanks for the signal and attachments, Tessa. I briefly scanned the helio_trace file. A few clarifying Qs before we scope work:

- Do you have a consistent request pattern (same prompt size / temperature) where this surface is reproducible?
- Can you share the request IDs or timestamps from the traces so we can correlate with runtime logs?

Preliminary thought: the behavior smells like an eviction/kv-cache mismatch when switching variants under prefetch. If prefetch primes the KV cache for one variant and then we switch to a different binary/quantization variant, the runtime may drop the streaming finalization path in corner cases.

Short-term: We can add a tenant-level config to suppress prefetch for specific routing decisions fairly quickly (Dev: please weigh in on effort).

Telemetry: exposing variant_id + prefetch_state in the SDK payload makes sense. We'll need to coordinate product + SDK maintainers for release windows.

I'll take point to get runtime feasibility and timeline. Dev — can you review the trace and confirm whether the server shows an early stream termination or whether the client is closing? Also please list the runtime logs we need from Helio (request_id, node_id, variant_id).

-karthik

From: Andrew <andrew@heliohealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Streaming truncation during variant routing — SDK flag + telemetry ask

Thank you — added details and a short recording. Repro steps:
1) Start streaming request with prompt A (attached in partial_response_sample.json).
2) After ~6s we see partial output stream and then the connection closes with no end-marker.
3) Disabling prefetch in our test client reduces occurrences to ~3%.

Included in helio_trace_20261118.txt: request ids: r-2345, r-2378, r-2401 (timestamps included). We can pull more if you tell us which fields. Happy to hop on a call.

- Andrew
Helio Health — Platform Engineering
andrew@heliohealth.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Streaming truncation during variant routing — SDK flag + telemetry ask

Reviewed the trace and runtime logs (r-2345 / r-2378). Quick notes:
- Server shows stream finalization code path invoked but connection reset by peer on the client side. We also see an inconsistent kv_cache_version between the prefetch call and the subsequent active variant.
- Hypothesis: prefetch primes cache for variant A, routing decides to use variant B due to load/cost policy; when the runtime switches, we occasionally hit a path where the streaming frontier doesn't reconcile the primed KV and the new KV version => client sees EOF.

Short-term mitigation (low-risk): add tenant routing override to disable prefetch when variant fallback occurs. Implementation effort: small (48-72h) including deploy + canary. I can own the runtime change.

SDK telemetry: we can add a streaming header with variant_id/prefetch_flag and emit it in event envelope. SDK change is trivial for adding fields but needs product signoff on the schema and test matrix across Node/Python/Go. Estimate: SDK PR within 5 working days, release in next SDK patch cycle (2 weeks) after approvals.

Required from Helio: samples for the failing request ids (r-2345, r-2378, r-2401) and the client-side stream logs showing socket close. Also confirm which SDK languages they use (Node + Python?).

I'll schedule a small canary deploy for the routing toggle and post results.

Attachments: (none)

- Dev

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Streaming truncation during variant routing — SDK flag + telemetry ask

We need to be pragmatic — Helio is a high-priority pilot. My asks:
1) Runtime hotfix (disable prefetch per-tenant on fallback) shipped and canaried within 72 hours. This is a gating item for their demo next week.
2) SDK telemetry exposure is product-level but must be scoped as an adoptable, non-breaking change. Product signoff: add fields but keep them optional so older SDKs won’t break. Target window: SDK PR in 5 working days, release in 10 business days.
3) Temporary escalation: Offer Helio a configuration change (we disable prefetch for their tenant) and a shared monitoring dashboard for request IDs and truncation rate for 14 days.

Logistics: Dev — please send a short note with the exact config key and runtime API we’ll flip for Helio. Karthik — please confirm rollout plan and rollback criteria. Tessa — loop Helio and get the client logs (socket close) and confirm SDK languages.

- Marissa
Director, Sales Engineering

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Andrew <andrew@heliohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Streaming truncation during variant routing — SDK flag + telemetry ask

Thanks everyone — aligning plan and next steps below (mutual action plan):
- Today (Nov 20): Helio to provide client socket-close logs for r-2345/r-2378/r-2401 and confirm SDK languages (Andrew).
- Nov 21 (Dev): Runtime toggle implemented and canary deployed for Helio tenant (dev_patel). Config key: routing.prefetch.enabled = false (tenant-level).
- Nov 22 (Ops): Monitoring dashboard active; we’ll track truncation rate and request_id correlation (Logan).
- Nov 25 (SDK): SDK PR with optional telemetry fields (variant_id, cache_hit, prefetch_triggered) opened for review (karthik_iyer / SDK owners).
- Nov 30 (SE/Product): SDK patch release target (if no blockers).

I’ve attached helio_trace_20261118.txt and partial_response_sample.json. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HL-2026-0423.

If Helio agrees to the tenant toggle we’ll schedule the canary window and share dashboards. Andrew — please confirm you want the toggle on for demo in the next 24h.

Thanks — Tessa
